questions.explanation: A mirror swaps left and right, so the hands point the opposite way round the clock. In the mirror the clock looks like 4:55. Flip it back: the minute hand is really at 5 minutes, and the hour hand is just past 7. The real time is 7:05. Quick check: the two times always add up to 12:00 (4:55 + 7:05 = 12:00).

distractors.A: that is just reading the mirror image
distractors.C: hour right but minute hand read the wrong way round
distractors.D: minute hand right but hour hand read the wrong way round

questions.skill: Gears: direction and number of turns
questions.stem: Gear A turns once clockwise. Which way does gear D turn, and how many times?
questions.explanation: Touching gears turn in opposite directions: A clockwise, B anticlockwise, C clockwise, D anticlockwise. The teeth pass one at a time, so one turn of A (20 teeth) moves 20 teeth of every gear. Gear D has 10 teeth, so it turns 20 ÷ 10 = 2 times. (The gears in between don't change this.)

distractors.A: each gear turns the opposite way to the one it touches: count the steps
distractors.B: a smaller gear turns more times
distractors.D: turns the wrong way and divided the wrong way round

questions.explanation: Write at each corner how many ways there are to reach it: 1 along the bottom and left edges, then each corner = the corner to its left + the corner below it (but nothing comes through the road marked ✕). The number at F is 7. Without the roadworks it would be 10.

distractors.A: ignored the roadworks
distractors.C: counted one route twice
